author: Дмитрий Лукашов
scope: Standalone offline Python CLI that validates an explicit JSON slide structure and writes a PPTX with native editable text and tables using four fixed original layouts. Includes a bounded structural reader for its own generated format. No model, API, rendering engine, arbitrary template editing, image sourcing, animations, macros, network or private-core installation.
origin: New original PPTX writer, documentation, slide theme and invented teaching fixture prepared for this open-module task in November 2026 with AI assistance. Install/uninstall helpers adapt the same author's previously published MIT company-knowledge-kit v0.1.1 helpers; authorship and license retained. No private Lookatshow core, client presentation, third-party template, media, skill collection or font file copied. Python standard library only. User-supplied content retains its own rights.
output_format: PPTX / OOXML with native editable text objects and table cells

input_limits.text_fit: Conservative estimate; character caps do not guarantee a fit. No truncation or automatic font shrinking. Actual render must be inspected in the intended editor.

inspection_scope: Bounded structural inspection of presentation-kit/1 output only; not a general validator, renderer or security certification for arbitrary third-party decks.
installer_support: POSIX-only explicit-prefix native launcher; Windows runs the source CLI through Python. Actual native-host checks are separate from CI configuration.

search_intent.en: offline JSON to editable PPTX; deterministic presentation generation for AI agents; native editable text and tables
